exact_statement: For every integer m>=1, on a finite uniform cube with disjoint c,u, m-bit Z and three-bit Y, let q2=-1 exactly on c=0,Z=0 and let G have ordered Boolean cores (Maj3,y0,-y0,-Maj3) indexed by c+2u. Start with common frequency reference R=(8/13,2/13,1/26,1/26,1/26,1/26,1/26,1/26). Use the stage5 five-cell control law with weights (1/4,1/4,1/16,7/20,7/80), uniform inside each cell, and the actual control-occupancy prior. Through every physical core query carry R by frequency marginalization to the SAME reference for both children and all four cores. For every core-only adaptive restriction history with no repeated coordinate on a path, complete each path to three core queries. Every node has signed excess e=max(0,Delta C_Q-4 Inf_i)<=1/4. Every complete actual terminal has 4I-C_Q>1 and remains nonconstant. Allocate each node excess to its final descendants with their physical conditional probabilities: the cumulative debit on any final terminal is <=3/4 from its ONE inherited complete terminal surplus, leaving >1/4. The exact signed telescope therefore proves H(F)<=C_Q(F)<4I(F)-1/4 for F=q2G, all m. At m=1, after Y1=0, the relevant query Y2 has 1/100<Delta C_Q-4 Inf_Y2<1/40, and both actual child core pairs are nonconstant. No arbitrary-core, control-query, depth-independent or universal FEI assertion is made.
hypotheses: Uniform finite Boolean cube; entropy and reference cross entropy in bits.
Exactly the paired majority/literal cores and positive normalized core reference specified.
m>=1, event c=0,Z=0; fixed cell weights and actual flag prior retained.
Only physical Y queries, distinct along each branch; all actual terminal costs retained.
All negative query prices allocated cumulatively against one original complete terminal reserve; no reset.

exact_statement: For every integer m>=2, on uniform bits w,Y_1,...,Y_(2m) and sign control z, let b_m(Y)=(-1)^(sum_j Y_(2j-1)Y_(2j)), G_m=b_m(Y)+1{w=0,Y=0}(z-1), delta=2^(-(2m+1)). These are actual Boolean outputs in the two-fixed-controller branch algebra, reached by restricting c=0 in P_m=(-1)^(cw+sum_j Y_(2j-1)Y_(2j))+1{c=w=0,Y=0}(z-1). For actual spectral core label T and control-occupancy flag V, alpha=I_z(G_m)=delta, and replacing a global flag prior by the actual conditional flag law refunds exactly I(T;V), leaving H(V|T). This retained conditional flag entropy satisfies H(V|T)/I_z(G_m)>=m+3/2, so no finite universal local K pays it by queried-control influence after arbitrary first-core exposure. Meanwhile I(G_m)=m+(2m+2)delta and H(G_m)/I(G_m)<=3. Both actual core terminals remain; this is a conditional-flag-only payment obstruction, not a FEI disproof or a refutation of weighted tree/slack payment.

exact_statement: For arbitrary Boolean a,b on a finite uniform core cube, m>=1, t=2^(-2m), and F=q2G with paired cores (a,b,-b,-a) indexed by c+2u, q2 negative on c=0,Z=0, fix one positive common core reference and the five-cell law (1/4,1/4,1/16,7/20,7/80). In every adaptive physical core-only tree with distinct queries per path, carry the common reference by frequency marginalization and retain the actual flag prior. With d_v=Pr(a!=b|v), p_v the physical node probability, and J_v=h2(t d_v)-E_child h2(t d_child), the total expected flag decrement equals h2(t d_root)-E_leaf h2(t d_leaf) and is at most t h2(d_root)<=t, independent of depth. Consequently total positive complete-reference query excess over K times queried influence is at most total positive core-reference excess plus t h2(d_root). All terminal reference costs and prior debits remain. For the fixed Maj3/y0 cores and inherited R=(8/13,2/13,1/26,...,1/26), preserving the signed core prices yields 4I(F)-C_Q(F)>9/4 for all m>=1. No arbitrary-core payment of the retained positive excess or universal FEI theorem is asserted.
hypotheses: Uniform finite Boolean cubes and physical adaptive core-only queries; entropy and complete cross entropy in bits.
m>=1 and paired zero-sum cores are used to identify actual empty-control mass=t Pr(a!=b).
One common positive core reference, marginalized at each query; fixed five-cell weights and all actual terminal bills retained.
Tree stopping/query choices depend only on actual physical history; the single auxiliary thinning gate is independent of the whole input/history.
The >9/4 corollary is restricted to the exact A069 majority/literal reference and unused terminal bank. It does not recertify spent slack at partial children.
